sql_templates.description: Calculate index returns over the last 3 months
sql_templates.query: SELECT index_symbol, 100 * (MAX(close) - MIN(close)) / MIN(close) AS return_pct FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY index_symbol

sql_templates.description: Determine stage distribution change over the last 3 months
sql_templates.query: WITH stage_counts AS (SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY stage) SELECT stage, count, 100.0 * count / SUM(count) OVER () AS percent_change FROM stage_counts
